entries.subject: Schenk scientific raster products
entries.finding: Selected products supply documented numeric scientific views; no-data and special values remain missing.

entries.subject: Corrected Enceladus v2 DSK
entries.finding: The v2 DSK is retained as a source-intake and recipe proposal. Image-to-v2 alignment, prepared error, browser limb and feature qualification remain pending.
entries.revisitWhen: Image alignment and the prepared-shape qualification record are completed for the v2 source.

entries.subject: 2024 original v1 DSK and associated harmonics
entries.finding: README records that NAIF reprocessed imagery after errors in the original model.
entries.revisitWhen: A documented reconciled replacement changes the source decision.

entries.subject: Atmosphere, plume and interior presentation alternatives
entries.finding: No selected observed surface map supports a visible atmosphere, invented plume animation or interior lens.
entries.revisitWhen: A source-backed mapped product supports the claimed visible quantity.

entries.subject: Six calibrated Cassini VIMS observations with navigation backplanes
entries.finding: The selected six-observation set supplies Infrared ratio and Ice absorption under the pinned channel, mask, overlap and coverage rules. It remains partially supported and is not photometrically corrected.

entries.subject: Published global infrared display mosaic
entries.finding: NASA PIA24027 is an 8192 by 4096 RGB equirectangular map centered at zero longitude. It combines Robidel 2020 VIMS infrared maps and Bland 2018 controlled ISS detail, with seams and artifacts removed by the producer. Used as a false-color photographic composite, not as a numeric spectral measurement.

entries.subject: Published photometrically corrected numeric spectral maps
entries.finding: Read the full author manuscript, sections 3 to 5, Table 3 and Figure 11; checked the publisher landing page and INAF repository. The paper describes median 0.5-degree footprint bins and wavelength-dependent photometric correction and says maps are online, but the inspected releases exposed the paper and raw PDS archive, not a retrievable numeric map product. The figure retains polar gaps and residual seams. No numeric map was extracted from its color legend.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numeric map with coordinates and missing-data definitions is located, or a separately validated reproduction of the published method is undertaken.

entries.subject: Enceladus super-resolution infrared mapping
entries.finding: The 2025 EPSC-DPS abstract describes revised navigation, global photometric correction and overlap-based super-resolution. The inspected conference and institutional records did not expose a downloadable map or reproducible processing release.
entries.revisitWhen: The numeric maps, navigation and method release become retrievable.

entries.subject: Global geologic map units (Crow-Willard and Pappalardo 2015)
entries.finding: NASA Trek serves the published map as a 13-polygon GIS layer with unit names and colors. Its file download answered 'Access denied'; the public ArcGIS REST query returned the full geometry in the native frame (Plate Carree, central meridian 180, 252.1 km sphere, east-positive). Units are rasterized at pixel centers to a 2048 x 1024 grid with conflicts withheld. Gazetteer centres and an overlay on the Schenk 2024 mosaic show no longitude flip or visible offset. The paper itself returned HTTP 403, so its figure colors were not compared with the GIS renderer; equatorial and heavily cratered plains share one renderer color.

entries.subject: Overlapping unit polygons in the geologic map
entries.finding: The heavily cratered plains polygon has no holes where subdued cratered plains and northern lineated material sit (15-105 E, 30-76 N); northern lineated material also lies inside subdued cratered plains, and two small subdued cratered plains rings overlap equatorial cratered plains and central LH. Under the shared withhold-conflicts rule 3.41% of the sphere was gray, northern lineated material showed no cells and subdued cratered plains 6 km2. The grid now gives each shared cell to the smallest covering unit (geology-grid.py nestedUnits inner): no conflicts remain, 0.072% of the sphere is unmapped, northern lineated material shows 8,544 km2 and subdued cratered plains 17,223 km2. The Trek MapServer rendering also puts subdued cratered plains over heavily cratered plains but hides northern lineated material; the grid differs there on purpose so that every published unit shows.

entries.subject: Geologic map line features (ridges, troughs, scarps, contacts)
entries.finding: The companion Trek layer Cassini_ISS_GeologicMapFeatures_Global holds 13 polyline records in 13 symbol classes. Geology lenses on other bodies show polygon units only; drawing line symbols would need a renderer feature.
entries.revisitWhen: A shared route for published line symbols exists.
